extracted.name: Campfire Apple Pie
extracted.description: White bread, butter, and apple pie filling (or any of your choice) make a campfire classic in this easy recipe.
instruction_lines: Spray a cast iron pie cooker with nonstick cooking spray. Evenly spread one side of each slice of bread with softened butter. Lay a slice of bread, butter side down, into the cooker. Spoon on pie filling, and top with second slice of bread, butter side up.
Close up cooker, and cook over a hot campfire, turning occasionally, until the pie is hot and golden brown, about 4 minutes.
